default.card_desc: Extend NetSuite or replace one rigid SaaS tool with a focused micro-application that resolves a single bottleneck. No re-platform, no disruption to what already works. Most engagements start here.

Ship commercial products on built-in multi-instance provisioning and isolated per-tenant databases, with Mantle’s subscription primitives handling signup and access. Delivery becomes a configuration decision.

REST, GraphQL, webhook and message-based connectors linking Moqui to storefronts, ERPs, WMS platforms, payment and shipping providers, and data warehouses. Composable and MACH architectures are a natural fit.
Service-oriented design means an AI agent can call business logic over REST with nothing re-architected. We wire Moqui to the Model Context Protocol, with your authorization rules still enforced.
